name: snacktape
description: A video mixtape for replaying only your favorite YouTube moments.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:dist
scripts.build:dist: npx --yes --package typescript@5.9.3 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build.mjs && npm run smoke:dist
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run test:compiled && npm run build:dist
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run test:compiled
scripts.test:compiled: npx --yes --package typescript@5.9.3 tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
